Jurisphere.ai | Frontend Engineer, Backend Engineer, Design Engineer | Bangalore, India | Hybrid | Full Time

Jurisphere is building an enterprise-grade Legal AI platform used by top law firms in India and the US. We are building serious product and systems infrastructure around legal workflows, document intelligence, review systems, and AI-powered execution. This is not a generic SaaS dashboard product. Our engineers work on dense, high-utility interfaces, long-running async workflows, large document pipelines, and enterprise-grade reliability.

We are hiring engineers who care about product quality, code quality, and building systems that remain fast, maintainable, and predictable as the company scales.

Roles currently available:

• Senior Frontend Engineer, Full-Stack Capable: Frontend-heavy role focused on workflow builders, document viewers, async UI, performance, and long-term frontend maintainability. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Vlfnh0pMUynMy8e1vwfj7HSz...

• Senior Backend Engineer, Full-Stack Capable: Backend-heavy role focused on workflow orchestration, AI/document pipelines, APIs, reliability, observability, and cost/scale tradeoffs. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P4zW47eGJJsaEQC33J-WQ4Ik...

• Founding Design Engineer: Product design expert who can also code in React, build and maintain components/UI, and raise the overall quality and polish of the product. https://docs.google.com/document/d/11yF_8tnDe7E4Qrwj4OcXvlXf...

We work from Bangalore in a hybrid setup. Compensation is competitive for startup talent and includes meaningful ESOPs.

To apply, send your resume, a short introduction, and links to work / proof of work to sumit@jurisphere.ai.
